race.comment: SUMMER READY (10) goes on top after a narrow Tara second where she was beaten just over half a length despite racing wide throughout. She comes off a quick back-up, gets meaningful weight relief and has already won at around this trip. Bold showing anticipated. SPIRIT FOX (5) is the main danger, with his Lismore fifth better than it looks after beginning only fairly and being held up on the home turn, while his Grafton second two back gives him a solid form line despite a long run of outs. BELISTIC MAN (1) arrives off a Bundarra win by just under 3L and has two wins this prep, though this is a harder assignment than that picnic contest. SO BE INSPIRED (6) has been plain in two runs this campaign, but comes back from a Gold Coast CL2 into easier company, and can improve third-up. BEACHSIDE BABE (11) has been patchy this prep but has best figs that stack up. Not dismissing completely.
